result.reasoning: This "translation changes" commit introduced the `reloadText()` method, the `CommandParser.reload()` mechanism, and cached `helpText` field logic across AbstractCommand, InvalidCommand, OnlinePlayerArgCommand, PlayerArgCommand, CommandParser, and Server.java. The fix commit reverts this entire architecture — removing `reload()`/`reloadText()` and switching `getHelpText()` to compute the text on-the-fly instead of relying on a stale cached `helpText` field (the root cause of the "/help bug"). All files touched by the fix exactly match the files modified by this commit to introduce the buggy caching/reload scheme.
